task: Explicit quantitative stability of labeled cross-species rigidity

strongest_statement.domain: arbitrary labeled subsets of R3 with velocity diameter <= D
strongest_statement.conditioning: six anchors, sigma_min[u,v,d]>=sigma; both third-anchor line heights>=h
strongest_statement.hypothesis: normalized perpendicular cross-secant error <= epsilon on every nonzero cross edge
strongest_statement.conclusion: one explicit lambda,b; all residuals <= C epsilon, C <= 5586(D/h)^2(D/sigma)^5
strongest_statement.wedge_variant: uniform unnormalized wedge error omega gives residual <=2C omega/sigma
strongest_statement.exception_scope: equal velocities, duplicate labels, arbitrary near/opposite-line positions; no minimum all-pair speed

conditional_interfaces: C1 integration with intrinsic path-distance factor
current Hessian approximation requires secant control of DJ rows and the exact specified gradient current
cubic profile additionally requires individual species scalar symmetry and invariant domains with finite intrinsic diameter
small value defect implies derivative control only with a separately supplied curve scale and second-derivative bound
counterexamples: connected bounded full-span images, fixed initial noncoplanarity: defect<=delta/2 but every homothety error>=1/6
small sinusoidal charge amplitude with arbitrarily large regular-shell tangent derivative

reading_coverage.frozen_exact_note: complete 559-line source at its requested SHA256
reading_coverage.new_note: entire argument S1-S31, then all changed formatting/evidence lines
reading_coverage.new_helper: complete 262-line final source; no prior helper imported
reading_coverage.logs: complete baseline and all four intended assertion-failure tracebacks
reading_coverage.rational_certificates: generated exact matrix identity checked for every entry; no claim of manually reading every numeric entry
reading_coverage.old_receipts: source/artifact identities inspected and rehashed; not a new full reading of old Lean/memory arguments
reading_coverage.truncation_recovery: initial combined instruction display truncated; applicable reference text recovered in bounded calls

independence_limits: Authored extension. Finite dual certificates use a different algebraic formulation, not a separate author/reviewer. Old exact review/Lean evidence does not certify new inequalities.
proof_imports: Elementary Euclidean linear algebra and integration only; no external theorem, physical primitive, or literature value imported.
search_scope: Bounded stored-local-ref search only; commands/results in bounded_search.json. No freshness or global novelty claim.
failed_routes: Pointwise angle division loses uniformity at exceptional lines; finite inverse alone hides conditioning; value-defect differentiation fails. No failed baseline process.
